The candidate is close in structure (8 states, sensible siren/pot/fall decomposition, predicate-only labels, well-formed REWARD_MACHINE header with nonempty FINAL_STATES=u0, declared and accepting), but it has one fatal reward-safety flaw and several fidelity gaps.

1. FATAL - siren reward is farmable by pointless toggling. From u0, `(u0, switch_toggled & (!pot_boiling | !holding_food) & !siren_ringing) -> u0` is TRANSITIONED with reward `(u0, switch_toggled & !siren_ringing & (!pot_boiling | !holding_food), u0) -> 0.3`. Because `switch_toggled` is true on every switch toggle, also while the siren is silent (per the readings), an agent can toggle the switch forever in u0 and collect +0.3 per step. The same exploit exists from u2 (`(u2, switch_toggled & !siren_ringing) -> u2` self-loop, reward missing in REWARD_FUNCTION, but the pair is still declared), and completion rewards in u4/u5/u6/u7 (`(u5, switch_toggled & !siren_ringing, u0) -> -0.2`, `(u7, switch_toggled & !siren_ringing, u2) -> -0.2`) do not gate on the siren having been on, so even where present the -0.2 completion rewards are wrong-signed for the task's one useful toggle and punish the needed action instead. Fix: gate siren-completion rewards on `siren_ringing` at the previous step's state (i.e., only in states that encode a pending ring: u4, u5, u6, u7), and give 0 (or a small penalty) for toggles in u0/u1/u2/u3.

2. Regression encoding is broken. In u1/u3 the rule `(u1, !holding_food & !siren_ringing) -> u0` fires on EVERY post-fall step without a pickup, including plain idle steps, transferring to u0 with -0.5. This (a) drops the food-on-floor tracking after a single missed step, so the 'pick it up on your very next move' pressure disappears after one mistake and a later pickup is silently unrewarded, and (b) punishes waiting clients/other unavoidable concurrent events as harshly as ignoring the fall. The -0.5 magnitude also collides with the environment's own late-client fine, making the shaped signal ambiguous. Same defect in u3 (returns to u2, -0.5). The regressions should be explicit but bounded and the state should persist until the pickup occurs.

3. Pot-task fidelity gap. The deliberate `drop` that the task mandates ('put down what you hold next to the stove') gets no reward and is indistinguishable from standing still: `(u2, !holding_food & !siren_ringing) -> u2` is a silent self-loop, and the same rule also fires after `stove_fixed`, so the required re-pickup is the only thing distinguishing the two. Meanwhile `stove_fixed` in u2 pays +0.4 regardless of whether the agent ever put its item down, and `(u2, holding_food & !pot_boiling & !siren_ringing, u0) -> 0.1` lets the agent exit u2 by fetching NEW pantry food rather than re-picking the dropped portion. 4. 5. Minor: `(u1, food_fell & siren_ringing) -> u5` and u1's switch/stove/order rules with -0.5 fire on the same step the fall is pending; concurrent-event priorities (food_fell with switch_toggled, e.g. `(u4, food_fell & switch_toggled & !siren_ringing) -> u1`) silently discard the +0.3 siren completion the agent just earned.
